message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel line chart comparing validation performance over training steps for Baseline and Attributing on AppWorld and BFCL v3.","description":"Two side-by-side line charts plot Avg@8 (%) on the vertical axis against Training Steps (%) on the horizontal axis, with steps from 0 to 100 in increments of 10. In both panels, the gray dashed line with circular markers is Baseline and the solid magenta line with triangular markers is Attributing; legends appear at the lower right. Lines connect observations in increasing step order. AppWorld is the left panel; its vertical scale is about 15–60%. Both methods start near 18%. Attributing rises more quickly early on, stays above Baseline for most of the run, and ends near 59%, compared with Baseline near 55%. BFCL v3 is the right panel; its vertical scale is 40–70%. Both methods start near 42%. Attributing rises to about 65% by 30 steps and remains in the low-to-mid 60s, ending near 65%; Baseline fluctuates more, mostly in the low-to-high 50s, and ends near 57%. Values in chart_values are estimated from the plotted marks, not printed point
